SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT CL01.SLS_TAX_BILL_NO FROM KEPCMCL01 CL01 WHERE 1=1 AND CL01.ERP_SND_STATE_CD ='T' AND (CL01.MILE_CHK = 'N' OR CL01.MILE_CHK IS NULL) AND CL01.BILL_CNFRM_CHK = 'Y' AND (( CL01.ELCTR_TAX_BILL_PBLCTN_CHK='Y' AND CL01.ATTR_1='Y') OR ( CL01.ELCTR_TAX_BILL_PBLCTN_CHK IS NULL ) OR ( CL01.ELCTR_TAX_BILL_PBLCTN_CHK = 'N' ) ) AND CL01.USE_CHK = 'Y' AND ROWNUM <= 100
